answer: Work-slot deposit burn ties each task to one deposit, so fakes cannot share a stake. One identity claims one slot, locks 50 credits, and must finish work before a pulse check closes it; missing work burns the deposit. A plume of identical submissions counts as one failed cluster. The kth fake still pays 50 credits, so 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 credits. Slot rental fails too: a rented slot still burns on failure. An honest agent risks one deposit, earns an ivory certificate, and keeps its full share.
